pokedexEntries.su: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokémon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it’s best suited to veteran Trainers.

pokedexEntries.mo: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

pokedexEntries.us: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.

pokedexEntries.um: Oranguru don’t get along with each other, so they’re always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.

pokedexEntries.sw: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sh: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.

pokedexEntries.sc: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.

pokedexEntries.vi: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.
